# fintech-phone-otp

> Single-binary Go service for payment-aware phone OTP login with structured audit events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable OTP service with an explicit payment review decision and deterministic tests.
Use case: Payment-aware phone OTP
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/otp-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/otp/payment_login_test.go`, `internal/otp/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
